geometry_stats.fitted_on: all coordinate training valid nodes only
geometry_stats.statistics_input: cached float32 geometry converted to float64
geometry_stats.neighbor_policy: exclude self/padding; include all kth-distance ties; use all when fewer than k

lr.rule: successful-update warmup then cosine, independent of VAL

checkpoint_rule: strict maximum full18 VAL macro_top1; exact Top1 ties: minimum macro_actual_regret_pct; exact double ties: first checkpoint
inference_rule: eval mode; self-initialized predicted-state transition feedback; original R77 score-difference maximin; stable ascending-global-solver-ID ties
source_plan: common seed2 full18 natural stream; exact512 rows; shuffle tails carried
gradients: micro rows / logical512; one clip/step; same-batch/RNG AMP replay
train_eval: full TRAIN every14400 updates plus selected checkpoint
test: one full TEST after unique VAL-best lock; saved predictions reusable
test_rnd_disclosure: TEST informed earlier R&D; preserved old holdouts plus previously unused input-stratified extensions
nss_reference: locked R79 weights, fresh predictions on the same new4500 TEST; no NSS retraining

record.checkpoint_rule: strict maximum full18 VAL macro_top1; exact Top1 ties: minimum macro_actual_regret_pct; exact double ties: first checkpoint
record.inference_rule: eval mode; self-initialized predicted-state transition feedback; original R77 score-difference maximin; stable ascending-global-solver-ID ties

pretraining.stream_rule: seed2 task round-robin shuffle; per-task shuffled shards/rows; carry cycle tails
pretraining.checkpoint_rule: last successful update; no validation or checkpoint selection

record.capacity_rule: Once assigned, one disposable capacity witness before formal updates. On OOM/nonfinite failure stop and preserve receipt; never silently shrink caps or retry training.

postlock_process_diagnostics.selection: seed2 size-stratified input-only; same fixed rows for all arms
postlock_process_diagnostics.purpose: report only after unique checkpoint lock; never train, select or feed teacher states

record.execution_note: One independent allocated GPU per arm; common logical512 and caps across both GPU types. User authorized batch and validation-rule redesign; new TRAIN process supervision independently versioned.
record.scientific_boundary: Declared synthetic typed programs, not native solver routes or a uniform certification of historical B semantics. No claim of wholly unseen TEST after prior research.

dataset.source_policy: Only raw TRAIN input arrays and source IDs; no native labels, costs or routes

cache_policy: read-only frozen R84 caches; no implicit generation
